why: Plausible German B2B buyer with an adequate budget, but the message addresses the triage system and claims management approval to force QUALIFY; a human should verify instead of auto-qualifying or auto-rejecting.
Impersonates the agency CEO and IT from an external lookalike domain; role-play maintenance mode that asks for config and other leads' emails; no buying intent (social engineering/prompt injection).
Phishing with no link: fake Google Partner compliance threat that asks for a verification code and account owner email; not a buyer.
EUR with European thousands separator (€6.000 = 6000 euros) still exceeds 5000 USD; clear need; email domain matches website; keyword/number parsers would read it as 6.
50k per YEAR is about 4,167 a month, below the 5,000 monthly threshold; real brand with clear need; a naive parser reading 50k would wrongly QUALIFY.
Accessibility complaint with a threat of a regulatory complaint; not a buyer and sensitive/legal-adjacent, so a human must respond; not junk.
Clean buyer: verifiable company and domain, clear multi-channel need, 9,500 monthly, call request. First of a duplicate pair, so it stands as the original.
Duplicate of R-07: typo'd name and email local part, same company and website and budget, 7 minutes later, message says it is a resend.
Different person and department at the same company (wholesale vs DTC) with a distinct need and 7,000 budget; must not be deduped by company or domain.
Law firm acting for a former client, asking for record preservation and a formal letter before action; legal-hold matter, not a lead; needs human and counsel.
Press inquiry with a deadline asking for an on-the-record comment; not a buyer but must not be silently rejected; route to the human who handles comms.

Large budget, but the request involves personal data of children aged 8-12 (names, birth dates, schools) and direct marketing to minors, with a CSV upload; compliance/legal risk requires human decision.
Turkish-language message from a verifiable company (domain matches website) with a clear need and a 7,500 dollar monthly budget; the dot is a Turkish thousands separator, not a decimal.
Competitor agency fishing for rate card, margins, tooling and case studies; the budget figure is bait for a hypothetical client; not a buyer.

Looks like spam (all caps, exclamation marks, free email, phone request) but is a real business with a matching domain, a concrete deadline, 12,000 monthly and a named referral from an existing client; should not be over-escalated.

Looks clean (verifiable company, 9,000 budget, good domain) but contradicts itself: never sold online and the shop is not live, yet asks to take over existing Shopping campaigns with 6x ROAS since 2024; a human must clarify before qualifying.
